border-style.$description: Style of the composer border (solid; dashed is set by the application, not animated).

border-color.$description: Same default as the fields (lcInput): sys.color.border-strong.

thumb-preview-height.$description: Height of the preview area of an attachment thumbnail.

remove-size.$description: Visible diameter of the remove button of a thumbnail (the click area stays sys.control-height-md).

enter-scale.$description: Scale an attachment thumbnail starts from when it fades in (unitless number).
